description_en: Queries the current status of an instance
kebab_example: aliyun alidns describe-gtm-instance-status --lang en --instance-id gtm-cn-wwo3a3hbz00 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeGtmInstanceStatus

AddrPoolNotAvailableNum.description_en: The number of unavailable address pools

Status.description_en:
The status of the instance. Valid values:

ALLOW: Operations are allowed.

DENY: Operations are denied
Status.description_zh:
实例状态：

ALLOW：允许操作
DENY：不允许操作

StatusReason.description_en:
A list of reasons for the instance status. Valid values:

INSTANCE_OPERATE_BLACK_LIST: The instance is in a blacklist.

BETA_INSTANCE: The instance is in public preview
StatusReason.description_zh:
实例状态原因列表

INSTANCE_OPERATE_BLACK_LIST：黑名单
BETA_INSTANCE：公测期实例

StrategyNotAvailableNum.description_en: The number of access policies for which the active address pool is unavailable
StrategyNotAvailableNum.description_zh: 当前生效地址池不可用的访问策略个数

SwitchToFailoverStrategyNum.description_en: The number of access policies that are switched to the failover address pool
SwitchToFailoverStrategyNum.description_zh: 切换到备用地址池的访问策略个数
